notes: Manufacturing model, shelf life, processing, logistics and input details come from general knowledge, not the evidence.

food_beverage_category.value: Protein nutrition: ready-to-drink protein shakes, protein powders, and nutrition bars (Premier Protein, Dymatize, PowerBar)

brand_private_label_manufacturing.value: Owned consumer brands (Premier Protein, Dymatize, PowerBar), produced through third-party contract manufacturers

shelf_life_storage_condition.value: Shelf-stable ready-to-drink shakes and powders, stored at ambient temperature

processing_technology.value: Outsourced aseptic or retort bottling of shakes, plus powder blending and bar production by co-manufacturers

temperature_controlled_logistics.value: Products are shelf-stable and use ambient distribution, with no temperature control required

customer_channel_sales_mix.value: Mostly retail: club, mass, food, drug, convenience, specialty, e-commerce; small foodservice; club and mass are the largest customers

input_food_safety_exposure.value: Dairy protein (milk protein, whey) price exposure and reliance on co-manufacturers; milk allergen
